subject: Invoice routing and VAT mapping — Solstice Health allocation request
body:
--- Original message ---
From: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solsticehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Solstice Health Accounts <ap@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidated monthly statement request + cost center allocations

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing our month-end AP process and would like to receive a single consolidated invoice from Redwood that still preserves line-level allocation to our internal cost centers. Our requirements: 

- One consolidated PDF per month (we post one payment per consolidated invoice).
- Line items must include a 6-digit cost center code and project tag so we can import into our ERP.
- VAT: for EU-services portion, we need gross VAT shown per line and a separate total VAT line; for US services, zero VAT but show tax-id references.
- Remit: payments will come from a centralized treasury account (we’ll share bank remit details).

Can your billing team produce that template and confirm whether Redwood can deliver a combined invoice but with a CSV/Excel mapping file we can import? Also flag any known issues with reverse-charge handling for EU customers.

Thanks,
Lydia
Lydia Park
Head of Finance Operations
Solstice Health

--- Reply ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated monthly statement request + cost center allocations

Hi Lydia — thanks for the clear list. We can do the consolidated PDF + line-level allocation, and produce a companion Excel mapping file. I’ve looped in Ben (billing) to confirm format and Karthik (tax) to confirm VAT/reverse-charge treatment. Naomi will coordinate the payment remit details with your AP inbox.

Action items I’m proposing: 
1) Ben: propose a PDF invoice layout and an exportable CSV/Excel schema for cost center import (include columns: invoice_line_id, amount, cost_center, project_tag, vat_amount, service_country).
2) Karthik: confirm how we should present reverse-charge and EU VAT IDs on the invoice (line vs summary).
3) Naomi: collect Solstice bank remit and confirm payee and reference string.
4) I will produce a draft invoice and send by end of day Thursday 9/3 for your review.

Attachment: proposed_invoice_template_v1.pdf (draft layout)

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example
+1 415-555-0191

--- Internal reply (Ben) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>, Lydia Park <lydia.park@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated monthly statement request + cost center allocations

Marissa / team — we can produce the consolidated PDF plus a machine-readable XLSX export that contains one row per invoice line. I attached a sample mapping workbook (solstice_costcenter_mapping.xlsx). Notes: 
- Column set I’m proposing: invoice_number, invoice_date, line_description, line_amount, currency, cost_center_code (6 digits), project_tag, service_country, vat_rate, vat_amount, net_amount.
- For posting, Solstice wants a single payment per consolidated invoice. We will include a payment reference string: SOL-<customer-invoice-number>-<month>. Please confirm if that fits your automated import.
- Banking & remit: we need the paying entity legal name + IBAN/ACH routing. Naomi, can you follow up?

Attached: solstice_costcenter_mapping.xlsx (15 KB)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

--- Internal reply (Karthik) ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solsticehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated monthly statement request + cost center allocations

Quick tax note: For EU-domiciled services where Solstice provides a valid VAT ID, we should show net amount on the line and a VAT line that indicates "Reverse charge — VAT due by customer" with the VAT amount calculation visible in the Excel export (so their ERP can apply the reverse charge). For UK customers, show UK VAT number and follow GB reverse charge guidance if applicable. For US services, show tax-id references and zero VAT.

Important: We need Solstice’s VAT/Tax IDs per legal entity to include on the invoice header. Lydia — can you provide the list of VAT IDs and the mapping to internal cost centers? If any lines are for taxable UK supply, note that separately so we can apply the correct rate.

Karthik
Senior Tax Counsel
Redwood Inference

--- Internal/Final (Marissa) ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
To: Lydia Park <lydia.park@solsticehealth.com>, Solstice Health Accounts <ap@solsticehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.example>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
Date: Fri, 03 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Deliverable: draft invoice + import file for September (action needed)

Hi Lydia / AP team — attaching the draft consolidated invoice and the Excel mapping file for your ERP import. Key points: 
- One consolidated PDF (page 1: invoice summary + header with legal entity and VAT IDs you've provided; pages 2-n: line-level breakdown with cost center codes).
- Accompanying XLSX contains one row per invoice line and includes vat_amount and the recommended import column set.
- Reverse-chargeable EU lines are annotated in the "vat_note" column as "reverse_charge".
- Payment reference: SOL-INV-202609. Please ensure your treasury uses that string on the payment so we can auto-apply.

Next steps for Solstice: 
1) Confirm the attached mapping file columns match your ERP import.
2) Share the list of legal VAT/Tax IDs and the bank remit (IBAN/ACH).
3) If accepted, we will finalize the template and enable monthly auto-delivery starting Oct 2026.

Attachments: proposed_invoice_template_v1.pdf; solstice_costcenter_mapping.xlsx; bank_remit_instructions.txt

Thanks everyone — ping me if you want a 20-minute walkthrough.

Best,
Marissa
Strategic Accounts Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.example
